Rewired synthesizeVoice to try this FIRST (new openRouterSpeak() + openRouterElevenVoices fixed 21-name list + openRouterElevenModel/defaultOpenRouterVoice='lily'), then the existing direct-ElevenLabs-key chain as a fallback (unchanged, still fully tested), then the old generic OpenRouter TTS as last resort. handleAIVoices now returns the OpenRouter fixed-name list (no network call, matches what synthesis actually uses) whenever an OpenRouter key exists, falling back to the live ElevenLabs catalog fetch only when there is no OpenRouter key -- caught and fixed a real ordering bug here via smoke test (it was checking the direct ElevenLabs key first, so a stale/rejected key sitting in SWARM's shared .env silently blocked the new OpenRouter list from ever showing), added a regression test for it. Added openRouterAudioURL test seam + 6 new tests (fakeOpenRouterAudio server) covering: OpenRouter tried first even with a direct key present, chosen voice name passed through, unknown/raw-ID voice falls back to lily, direct ElevenLabs used as fallback on OpenRouter failure, and the listing-priority bug.
